correctness.rationale: For reversible P, H=D^(1/2)PD^(-1/2), SLEM=||H-vv^T||, a convex symmetric norm; dihedral subgroup preserving alternating masses acts transitively on cycle edges, justifying global averaging to uniform conductance w. Fourier 2x2 blocks have extremes 1-(S-Psi)w and 1-2Sw; minimax of decreasing and increasing affine branches gives w*=min{B/2,2/(3S-Psi)}. Threshold algebra yields A/B<=2/(1+cos²(pi/n)), with boundaries valid n>=3. Independently compared to all-parameter earlier theorem on 25 sample points, verifying matching formulas. Analytic proof supports all n and masses.
